summary: T340 landed and committed (aa636d08 + 85d44f25 ledger wrap, branch loop-t340 in /tmp/chug-loop-t340). Implemented exactly the spec's named targets: (1) src/daemon.rs — the T340 status section: /status/loop renders {contract_version, status: working|blocked|idle|dormant, cycle_id, iteration, item_id, blocked_reason, blocked_detail, children, as_of} from bounded read-only reads of the loopd state files (.chug/loopd pid/HALTED/cycle logs, .chug/events.jsonl 64KiB tail, TODO.md, .git/worktrees); the T328 missing-repo case surfaces as blocked/external naming the path; budget-abort → blocked/budget with named detail; HALTED latch → blocked/error; children enumerate impl/validate/worktree git worktrees (pure file reads, no subprocess) with ready/locked/prunable/detached states; /status/items renders the open TODO queue ({id,title,pri,status,blocked_reason?}); ?repo= (percent-decoded) > CHUG_DAEMON_REPO > daemon cwd; legacy routes keep RAW-path matching (query on /healthz,/judge,/sessions still 404s); /sessions, /judge, /healthz untouched; the stub serves /healthz only and refuses /status like /sessions. (2) src/capabilities.rs — spec §3 registration: one bounded probe (GET /status/loop on the 2s daemon-socket bound; absent/stale/refusing daemon = all-off, never hangs) merged additively — daemon_status true + lifecycle_events "1" only when a live daemon answers; document() stays pure, versions.daemon null (health compat-protected). (3) tests/daemon_status_contract.rs (9 wire tests incl. each status enum value from canned loopd state, blocked/external naming the path, children impl+validate worktrees, exact-keys vs docs/meta-harness.md + pinned fixture tests/fixtures/daemon_status/status-loop-v1.json, bounded socket-absent degrade, capabilities flip, stub refusal, legacy untouched) + 16 daemon.rs and 4 capabilities.rs units. Gates all green: cargo build --release, clippy --all-targets --release -- -D warnings ZERO, the check target cargo test --release --test daemon_status_contract 9/9 run verbatim, plus T339 compat suites capabilities_contract 7/7, daemon_lifecycle 3/3, daemon_sessions_registry 8/8, daemon_feature_off 5/5, and daemon::tests+capabilities::tests 50/50 [CARGO_TARGET_DIR=target-shared]. No daemon process was touched.
